concepts.Personality: governed candidate-level pattern of trait dimensions across bounded evidence, contexts, and time
concepts.Trait Candidate: one dimension/value proposal with evidence, uncertainty, contradiction, counterexample, and lineage
concepts.Profile Candidate: structured non-flattened set of trait candidates, including uncertain or contradictory candidates
concepts.Preference: choice/affinity evidence that may inform personality but is not personality by itself
concepts.Emotion: context-bound state evidence; not stable personality structure
concepts.Learning Pattern: learning-owned pattern evidence; not automatic trait activation
